description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of various models across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the categories, while the vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62, marked at intervals of 2. Each category is represented by a group of five bars, corresponding to different models: DAPO+Self-reflection (blue), DAPO (light blue), SRPO (orange), GRPO (beige), and PPO (green). In the Mathverse category, the bars have approximate values of 56.2 (DAPO+Self-reflection), 53.2 (DAPO), 55.8 (SRPO), 53.4 (GRPO), and 53.4 (PPO). In the MMLU category, the values are approximately 57 (DAPO+Self-reflection), 56 (DAPO), 57 (SRPO), 56 (GRPO), and 54.8 (PPO). In the Physics category, the values are around 61.4 (DAPO+Self-reflection), 58 (DAPO), 61 (SRPO), 58.2 (GRPO), and 56.8 (PPO). The bars within each group are not stacked, and the models are differentiated by distinct colors as indicated in the legend. The bars are grouped by category, with no specific sorting order within the groups. No bars are visually emphasized.
